# Pure Python OLS verification

# X is month index (1 to 36), Y is yield
X = list(range(1, 37))
Y = [3.25, 3.22, 3.19, 3.06, 3.04, 2.96, 2.90, 2.85, 2.73, 2.70, 2.72, 2.70,
     2.62, 2.60, 2.64, 2.65, 2.68, 2.68, 2.77, 2.92, 2.92, 2.92, 2.91, 2.91,
     2.96, 3.02, 3.00, 2.96, 2.96, 2.97, 2.94, 2.93, 2.98, 3.10, 3.03, 2.98]

n = len(X)
sum_x = sum(X)
sum_y = sum(Y)
sum_xy = sum(x*y for x, y in zip(X, Y))
sum_x2 = sum(x*x for x in X)
sum_y2 = sum(y*y for y in Y)

# Calculate slope and intercept
beta = (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / (n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x)
alpha = (sum_y - beta * sum_x) / n

# Calculate R-squared
y_pred = [alpha + beta * x for x in X]
ss_res = sum((y - y_pred)**2 for y, y_pred in zip(Y, y_pred))
ss_tot = sum((y - sum_y/n)**2 for y in Y)
r_squared = 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)

print(f"Number of observations: {n}")
print(f"Sum X: {sum_x}, Sum Y: {sum_y}")
print(f"Sum XY: {sum_xy}, Sum X²: {sum_x2}")
print(f"\nIntercept (α): {alpha}")
print(f"Slope (β): {beta}")
print(f"R-squared: {r_squared}")
print(f"\nEquation: Y = {alpha} + {beta} * X")
print(f"         Y = {alpha:.6f} + {beta:.10f} * X")

# Predict July 1956 (month index 37)
july_1956_pred = alpha + beta * 37
print(f"\n*** Forecast for July 1956: {july_1956_pred} ***")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(july_1956_pred, 3)}")
